knowledge_gaps: Recency-weighted training positions do not directly suppress old interests at inference. The report needs evidence distinguishing this training emphasis from actual temporal forgetting.

The combined proposal lacks controlled comparisons: corrected baseline, BPR-max alone, recency weighting alone, and their combination. Specify a budget-feasible comparison and checkpoint-selection rule using fixed macro validation HR@10.

Sampling details remain ambiguous: whether 32 negatives are independently sampled per position or shared per user, whether duplicates are allowed, and how training user IDs reach the exclusion sampler. Define score tensor shapes, empty-candidate handling, and bounded sampling retries.

Reproduction requires the inherited optimizer settings, batch size, learning-rate schedule, gradient clipping, validation frequency, and exact BPR-max gradient behavior. The difficulty score of 3 may underestimate efficient negative scoring and exclusion handling.

Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting. Report paired uncertainty and category-level results without changing the pinned evaluator or consulting test labels.

Unavailable category metadata must be marked unavailable in diagnostics; empty category lists do not establish that no problematic categories exist. Near-zero mean embedding cosine also cannot rule out every form of representation collapse.
